note: Static web/src/pages/index.astro; divisionsWithContent(allPieces()) uses data/catalog.json.
[division]/index.astro getStaticPaths uses divisionsWithContent; indexes.ts maps temporale to proper-of-time. data/catalog.json includes temporale piece dominica-i-adventus.
day/[flex]/[name].astro getStaticPaths uses catalogedDays(allPieces()); data/catalog.json dominica-i-adventus.days includes tempora:Adv1-0, the First Sunday of Advent.

piece/[slug].astro getStaticPaths includes every data/catalog.json piece; this proper has 28 systems and is not a Kyriale redirect. data/typeset/manifest.json has all five part:dominica-i-adventus targets; their lengths meet suspects.ts thresholds. Catalog sections pair chants 132, 1169, 1115, 962 and 1036; data/chants.json includes their notation (132 is Ad te levavi).

piece/[slug].astro getStaticPaths includes data/catalog.json s-matthi-apostoli (S. Matthiæ Apostoli), eight systems and no whole-piece reference. data/typeset/manifest.json has no targets for this slug, so its own music is scans only.
vespers/[date].astro getStaticPaths maps loadLineup().days; data/vespers/vespers-lineup.json days[2026-11-08] is II Vespers of tempora:Epi5-0, a Sunday in November 2026.

vespers/[date]/i.astro getStaticPaths maps loadLineup().firstVespers; data/vespers/vespers-lineup.json first_vespers[2026-11-01] is I Vespers of sancti:11-01 (All Saints, I class), evening_of 2026-10-31.
Static web/src/pages/kyriale/index.astro; Kyriale groups use data/catalog.json.
kyriale/[mass].astro getStaticPaths maps ordinaryMasses() labels to lowercase; data/catalog.json ordinarium-missae-i has label I, genre mass_ordinary and division kyriale.
ordinary-form/[key].astro getStaticPaths maps ordinaryFormOccasions(); data/ordinary-form-propers.json occasions includes mapped key advent-1, 1st Sunday of Advent, with catalogued lenders.
Static web/src/pages/calendar/index.astro; dayIndex and ordinaryMasses use data/catalog.json, with date data in data/calendar/.
Static web/src/pages/calendar/ordinary-form/index.astro; occasion choices come from data/ordinary-form-propers.json.
Static web/src/pages/good-friday/index.astro; goodFridayRites() reads data/good-friday.json, with notation from data/chants.json.
Static web/src/pages/hymns/index.astro; hymnIndex/loadCatalog use data/catalog.json and hymnPairing uses data/hymn-pairings.json.
Static web/src/pages/search.astro; ordinaryMasses uses data/catalog.json; search index is supplied by the production build.
Static web/src/pages/corrections/index.astro; correction targets come from data/catalog.json. No form submission action.
Static web/src/pages/corrections/log/index.astro; correctionsLog() reads data/corrections-log.json.
Static web/src/pages/about.astro; counts use data/catalog.json and data/vespers/vespers-lineup.json.

web/src/pages/404.astro generates Astro's explicit 404.html artifact; no getStaticPaths or slug data. The runner requires HTTP 200 for this explicit artifact too and reports failure if the preview serves it with status 404.
